unchanged.detail: Vault/ERC4626-like accounting signals were detected, but no non-placeholder invariant/property testing signal was found.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical vault/accounting failure classes where broken share valuation or manipulated accounting state caused loss.
unchanged.recommendation: Add Foundry invariants for share/accounting conservation across deposit, withdraw, donation, fee, and emergency scenarios.
suggested_tests: Add a Foundry invariant that checks totalAssets and share accounting conservation across deposit, withdraw, donation, and fee scenarios.
unchanged.title: Vault accounting without invariant tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Vault bugs often appear when shares, assets, totalSupply, totalAssets, and external balances drift from assumptions used during deposits and withdrawals.

unchanged.detail: Preview function signals were detected, but test files do not visibly cover previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw, or previewRedeem.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to share/accounting mismatch classes where quoted and realized vault state diverge.
unchanged.recommendation: Add tests that preview functions match actual state-changing outcomes within documented rounding bounds.
suggested_tests: For each preview function, compare the previewed shares/assets with the actual deposit, mint, withdraw, or redeem result.
unchanged.title: ERC4626-like interface without preview function tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: ERC4626 integrations often rely on preview functions for quotes and UX; inconsistent previews can create user and integration risk.

unchanged.detail: Shares/assets conversion signals were detected without visible decimals, precision, mulDiv, or rounding test coverage.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical arithmetic and accounting mismatch classes where precision assumptions failed.
unchanged.recommendation: Add tests for rounding direction, small values, decimals mismatch, and conversion reversibility.
suggested_tests: Fuzz assets and shares across small, large, and decimal-edge values and assert conversion error stays within documented bounds.
unchanged.title: Shares/assets conversion without rounding tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Small rounding mistakes in conversion functions can compound into unfair share issuance, redemption drift, or stranded assets.

unchanged.detail: totalAssets appears connected to external strategy, pricing, or balance assumptions without visible manipulation-resistance test coverage.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to Harvest/Yearn-style vault readiness classes where pricing or strategy state influenced share accounting.
unchanged.recommendation: Test totalAssets under donated assets, mocked strategy gain/loss, and mocked stale or bounded pricing where relevant.
suggested_tests: Mock external strategy or price state and assert totalAssets, share price, and withdrawal accounting remain within documented policy.
unchanged.title: totalAssets external dependency without manipulation-resistance tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Vault share value often depends on totalAssets; external balances, strategies, or prices can make the accounting view drift from user expectations.

unchanged.detail: Strategy, harvest, debt, gain, loss, or migration signals were detected without visible strategy lifecycle tests.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to strategy debt/gain/loss accounting readiness classes.
unchanged.recommendation: Add tests for strategy report, harvest, gain, loss, debt changes, withdrawals, and migration or emergency exit if present.
suggested_tests: Use a local mock strategy that reports gain and loss, then assert totalAssets and share accounting follow documented policy.
unchanged.title: Strategy accounting without gain/loss tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Strategy vaults can look solvent until gain/loss, debt, or migration paths update accounting in unexpected ways.

unchanged.detail: Withdrawal queue, cooldown, epoch, pending withdrawal, or liquidity-buffer signals were detected without visible lifecycle tests.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to vault lifecycle readiness classes where exit accounting or liquidity assumptions can break.
unchanged.recommendation: Add tests for request, cooldown/epoch movement, claim, cancellation, and insufficient-liquidity behavior.
suggested_tests: Test the full withdrawal lifecycle and assert shares/assets are conserved across request, cooldown, claim, and cancellation.
unchanged.title: Withdrawal queue/cooldown without lifecycle tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Delayed withdrawals create state machines; audit preparation should prove shares and assets are conserved through each state.

unchanged.detail: Oracle, price-feed, pool-price, reserve, TWAP, or LP pricing signals were detected without enough stale-price, bounds, or sanity-check coverage.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical vault/oracle and pool-price manipulation readiness classes.
unchanged.recommendation: Add local mock price tests for stale rounds, decimals normalization, price bounds, and fallback behavior.
suggested_tests: Use local mock oracles/pools to test stale, out-of-bounds, decimals, and spot-price scenarios without live-chain calls.
unchanged.title: Oracle-dependent vault without stale-price or bounds tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Vaults that price assets, LP tokens, or strategies through external sources need explicit assumptions around stale, spot, and bounded prices.

unchanged.detail: Fee terms were detected without visible tests for fee accounting, recipient balances, or conservation around fee paths.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to accounting mismatch classes where protocol fees changed conservation assumptions.
unchanged.recommendation: Add deposit, withdrawal, management, and performance fee tests where relevant.
suggested_tests: Assert user shares, treasury shares/assets, and totalAssets remain consistent before and after fee-bearing operations.
unchanged.title: Fee logic without fee accounting tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Fee logic changes share issuance, redemption value, and treasury balances; missing tests make audit review slower and riskier.

unchanged.detail: Pause or emergency signals were detected without visible tests for blocked flows and documented recovery behavior.
unchanged.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to operational readiness classes where emergency behavior changes core state transitions.
unchanged.recommendation: Add tests showing pause/emergency controls block risky flows and preserve documented exit or recovery paths.
suggested_tests: Assert pause and emergency states block or allow each vault flow exactly as documented.
unchanged.title: Pause/emergency controls without operational tests
unchanged.why_it_matters: Emergency controls are launch-critical; they should behave predictably under stress without bypassing accounting assumptions.
